findings.current: If so, using informal speech while getting beaten was better for my mental health.
findings.defect: The draft replaces Taekyung’s joking idea of claiming a psychological or moral victory with a general claim about mental health, weakening both the joke and his characterization.
findings.rationale: 정신 승리 means consoling oneself by claiming a victory despite actually losing, not improving one’s mental health.
findings.replacement: If so, using informal speech while getting beaten at least let me claim a moral victory.
findings.source: 기왕이면 반말 쓰고 맞는 게 정신 승리에 도움이 된다.

findings.current: The more the skin on his palms split and healed, the faster and stronger his spear became.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit quantity that his palms split and healed dozens of times.
findings.rationale: 수십 번 explicitly establishes the repeated physical toll of Taekyung’s seven years of training.
findings.replacement: His palms split open and healed dozens of times, and with each cycle, his spear became faster and stronger.
findings.source: 손바닥 가죽이 수십 번 찢어지고 아물수록 그의 창도 빠르고 강해졌다.

findings.defect: The thought shifts from astonishment that such a feat is actually possible to a straightforward acknowledgment that Taekyung accomplished it.
findings.rationale: 이게 되네 expresses Jin Mukyung’s disbelief that the result could happen at all.

findings.current: Jin Mukyung answered with an unconvinced expression and sheathed his sword.
findings.defect: “Unconvinced” implies that Jin Mukyung doubts someone else’s claim, whereas the source describes him as visibly uneasy or not entirely comfortable with his own excuse.
findings.rationale: 석연치 않은 describes lingering unease or dissatisfaction, fitting his awareness that he broke his promise not to use Sword Energy.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung answered with a distinctly uneasy expression and sheathed his sword.
findings.source:
“……그걸 곧이곧대로 믿은 놈이 멍청한 거지.”

영 석연치 않은 얼굴로 대답한 진무경이 검을 집어넣었다.

findings.defect: “Expired” implies that the countdown naturally reached zero, but the System removes the still-remaining time because Jin Mukyung ended the training.
findings.rationale: 소멸합니다 means the remaining time disappears; the preceding panel explicitly showed that two hours and twenty-two minutes were still left.

findings.current: “After ten days, this is all you can do? What a waste of my ti—”
findings.defect: The draft drops the relational action of Taekyung keeping up with Jin Mukyung, turning the line into a generic criticism of Taekyung’s ability.
findings.rationale: 못 따라오다 specifically means failing to follow or keep pace with someone, which supports Jin Mukyung’s deliberately dismissive evaluation.
findings.replacement: “To think this is all you managed to keep up with me after ten days. What a waste of my ti—”
findings.source: “열흘 동안 고작 이 정도밖에 못 따라오다니. 내 시간이 아깝…….”

findings.current: Jin Mukyung’s eyes rolled back as he lunged toward me.
findings.defect: The draft makes Jin Mukyung actually lunge, but the source says he was only about to charge when the interruption occurred.
findings.rationale: 달려들려던 marks an intended action interrupted before completion; preserving that interruption is necessary for the scene’s physical sequence.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung’s eyes went wild, and he was just about to charge at me.
findings.source: 눈깔이 뒤집힌 진무경이 내게 달려들려던 그 순간이었다.

findings.current: Something had clearly happened while we had not seen him. His face was covered in bruises, and four or five of his teeth were missing.
findings.defect: The draft changes Childeuk’s teeth from broken to missing.
findings.rationale: 부러졌다 explicitly means the teeth were broken; the later narration also refers to them as 부러진 이빨.
findings.replacement: Something had clearly happened while we had not seen him. His face was covered in bruises, and four or five of his teeth were broken.
findings.source: 못 본 사이에 무슨 일이 있었는지 얼굴은 멍투성이고 이빨이 네댓 개 부러졌다.

findings.current: In the modern world, there were potions, so there was hardly an illness that could not be cured. Murim was different.
findings.defect: “Hardly” weakens the source’s absolute statement and introduces possible incurable illnesses that the Korean explicitly excludes.
findings.rationale: 못 고칠 병이 없다 is an unqualified negative construction meaning there is no illness that cannot be cured.
findings.replacement: In the modern world, there were potions, so there was no ailment they couldn’t cure. Murim was different.
findings.source: 현실에서야 포션이 있으니 못 고칠 병이 없다지만 무림은 다르다.

findings.current: No matter how famous I had become lately, I was nowhere near Jin Mukyung’s level. Childeuk answered with a humbled expression.
findings.defect: “Jin Mukyung’s level” can mean martial strength or System Level rather than fame, and “humbled” does not convey Childeuk’s awed sense of being honored.
findings.rationale: 유명세 explicitly compares their fame, while 황송하다 conveys feeling overwhelmed and honored before a superior.
findings.replacement: I might have made a name for myself lately, but I was still nowhere near as famous as Jin Mukyung. Childeuk answered with an awestruck expression.
findings.source: 내가 근래 들어서 아무리 유명세를 떨치고 있다지만 진무경만큼은 아니다. 칠득이가 황송하다는 얼굴로 대답했다.

findings.current: “Only specially selected martial artists within our family can serve directly under the Lesser Family Head.”
findings.defect: The draft replaces Jin Mukyung’s kinship-specific reference to his eldest brother with an institutional title.
findings.rationale: 큰형님 explicitly identifies Jin Wikyung as Jin Mukyung’s eldest brother and preserves the family hierarchy emphasized in this exchange.
findings.replacement: “Only specially selected martial artists within our family can serve directly under our eldest brother.”
findings.source: “큰형님 직속은 본가 내에서도 선별된 무인들만 들어갈 수 있는 곳인데.”

findings.defect: The System panel omits Childeuk’s newly revealed surname, Jang.
findings.rationale: 장칠득 gives his full name, which is subsequently used in Jin Wikyung’s greeting and in the title 장 무인.

findings.current: “Childeuk, man of benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom! Our martial artist Childeuk, you’ve arrived!”
findings.defect: The draft omits the surname in both forms of address and converts “Martial Artist Jang,” a surname-based title, into the unnatural possessive phrase “our martial artist Childeuk.”
findings.rationale: 장칠득 is the full name, while 장 무인 addresses him by surname and his new status as a martial artist.
findings.replacement: “Jang Childeuk, a man of benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom! Is that you, Martial Artist Jang?”
findings.source: “인의예지를 갖춘 장칠득! 우리 장 무인 왔는가!”

findings.defect: The draft loses the emphatic, deferential cadence of Childeuk’s response.
findings.rationale: 옛 is a forceful deferential acknowledgment, and retaining that register supports Childeuk’s overeager voice toward Jin Wikyung.

summary: The draft contains one reversed action and several meaningful losses involving System mechanics, characterization, quantity, kinship, identity, and register.
